definition.summary: Support of a convolution along the sequence, in positions.
definition.description: The temporal extent of a kernel that slides along the sequence, whatever the stream: the frames of the audio stem's convolutions and the positions of a gated-delta layer's depthwise causal convolution are the same kind of dimension. Not an axis a shape composes along or a partition targets.
definition.note: support of a convolution along the sequence: audio frames or delta-rule positions
